text: Haan, theek hai, thoda time hai. I wanted to ask about your aloe vera juice, like what is the price, bottle size, and how to take it?
The NatureVeda Aloe Vera Juice costs 399 rupees for 500 ml and contains Aloe Vera. It is marketed as a general wellness beverage. Would you like to place an order today?
Acha, 399 rupees for 500 ml is fine, but I am still thinking about it.
No problem at all. Take your time to decide. Just let me know if you'd like to place an order later.
Abhi is call ko hum thoda Hindi mein continue karein kya?
Ji bilkul, hum Hindi mein baat kar sakte hain. Abhi ke liye hum English mein hi baat karte hain. Kya aap Aloe Vera Juice ke baare mein kuch aur jaanna chahenge?
Ji theek hai, aapne aloe vera juice ka price kya bataya tha, wo ek baar firse bataenge?
The NatureVeda Aloe Vera Juice costs 399 rupees for 500 ml.
Theek hai, aur hair oil mein kya ingredients hain?
The NatureVeda Herbal Hair Oil contains Amla, Bhringraj, Hibiscus, and Coconut Oil. It is intended for routine hair and scalp care and costs 499 rupees for 200 ml.
Achha, toh ek juice aur ek hair oil ka total kitna ho gaya?
One Aloe Vera Juice at 399 rupees and one Herbal Hair Oil at 499 rupees makes a total of 898 rupees.
Theek hai, 898 rupees ka total theek hai. Main isko baad mein soch kar bataungi, abhi ke liye shukriya, bye!
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
